summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that repairs to the primary ball mill trunnion at its Guanacev mine are complete and the replacement trunnion installed, restoring processing to full capacity after a September 22 disclosure. No securities, ownership, or transaction terms are involved; it is an operational update from a mid-tier silver producer with three operating mines in Mexico and Peru. There is no board recommendation or advisor, no stake, price, premium, or regulatory clock — a routine operational disclosure, not a special situation, with no risk-arb angle.
